next.reason: 1985: "[ COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1 ]"; 2023: "COLLATING SEQUENCE { IS alphabet-name-1 [ alphabet-name-2 ] | FOR ALPHANUMERIC IS alphabet-name-1 / FOR NATIONAL IS alphabet-name-2 }". Format 1 matches 1985 except COLLATING SEQUENCE, which adds alphabet-name-2 and FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL forms, so more programs are accepted.
